patches.title: Sink After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up a dirty object, go directly to the sinkbasin for cleaning without intermediate actions.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that requires cleaning.

patches.title: Check Destination Surface First
patches.principle: When the goal object may be on the destination surface, examine that surface before searching containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the destination is an open surface like a sofa or countertop.

patches.title: Finish One Furniture Type
patches.principle: When searching for a target, examine all containers of one type (e.g., all cabinets) before switching to another type.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target is not found on open surfaces.
